title: China Eats About 42 Billion Instant-Noodle Servings a Year | China Travel Expert
description:
Instant noodles are a global habit, but one country eats them like no other. According to the World Instant Noodles Association, the planet got through about 120 billion servings in 2023 — and China (with Hong Kong) accounted for roughly 42 billion of them, about a third of the entire world's total. The next biggest markets, Indonesia and India, aren't even close.

It's a funny contrast: the country that gave the world hand-pulled noodles and endless regional noodle soups is also the planet's instant-noodle champion. Both are real China dinners.

🧭 Expert Tip: On the road in China, the convenience-store instant-noodle wall is a traveller's friend — but for a few yuan more, a hole-in-the-wall bowl of fresh lamian or beef noodle soup beats any packet.

全球一年吃掉约 1200 亿份方便面，中国（含香港）约 420 亿份，约占三分之一——既是手工拉面的故乡，也是方便面第一大国。
